The USB id of base + this grip was not found (SimAppPro firmware file name ViperAce_Throttle_Grip_Matal_2). fwd/center/aft order of the slide switches follows the drawing order and is not stated in the manual.

devices.name: WinCtrl 32 NWS L / R 1.0 (Airbus nose wheel steering tiller, 32.NWS.L.1 / 32.NWS.R.1)

identify.note: Airbus A320-style tiller, left (captain) and right (first officer) versions with the same parts: tiller handle (+-75 deg) and PEDAL DISC button. 4098:B961 per the WinCtrl X-Plane plugin device table ('WINCTRL 32 NWS'); whether the L and R units report different PIDs is not known. The manuals (Winctrl Steering Handwheel Left/Right 1.0) give no axis letter or button number, so no inputs.

devices.name: Thrustmaster Warthog grip on WinWing Super Libra base (WinWing TM Grip Conversion Kit)

identify.note: WinWing sold a TM Grip Conversion Kit (shop id 321) that rewires a Thrustmaster HOTAS Warthog grip to the WinWing grip connector of the Super Libra (J1) base; the WinWing TM grip adapter install manual V1.0 shows the J1 base. The base then reports the grip's buttons; their numbering is not documented, so no inputs.

devices.name: WinWing Super Taurus F/A-18 Start-up Side Panel (18-STARTUP)

identify.note: Backlit F/A-18C left-console style side panel that is factory-mounted on the Super Taurus (T1) throttle base but has its own USB port (and a backup power port), so it is its own USB device (SimAppPro firmware names 18C_STARTUP_PANEL / F18_STARTUP_PANEL). Numbers 1-57 and the two knobs (Rx, Ry, 0-4095) from the WinWing '18 HANDLE + T1 Super Taurus Throttle Base' manual V1.1 section 3 drawing, read as: number above a switch = up, beside = center, below = down; 40/41/42 = ENG CRANK left/center/right (drawn with arrows next to the APU switch 38/39 and the APU READY LED); 54-57 = 4-position rotary. The drawing prints no other switch names, so the remaining switches carry no label. USB id not found.
